title: Expedition verifier synthetic control behavior
claim: Under the frozen five-test synthetic suite, the canonical verifier core normalized answers consistently, accepted a matching digest, rejected a nonmatching digest, rejected empty normalized input, and rejected an unknown challenge ID.
why_it_matters: It establishes an inspectable software-control result before any Expedition package is opened to users.
controls: Positive and negative vectors are independent synthetic values.
The sealed Expedition 001 answer is absent from the suite.
limitations: This result covers the verifier core, not desktop usability or packaging.
It does not validate the sealed Expedition answer.
does_not_claim: That the Windows package is publicly released.
current_interpretation: A reproduced known control for the verifier core; broader product qualification remains separately gated.
